name: poseidon
description: Poseidon — a beautiful personal atlas of your underwater life.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @poseidon/domain && npm run build --workspace @poseidon/web
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.check:assets: npm run validate:content && npm run validate:assets && npm run validate:source-assets && npm run test:assets
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @poseidon/domain && npm run typecheck --workspace @poseidon/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @poseidon/domain && npm run test --workspace @poseidon/web
scripts.gate: npm run check:assets && npm run check && npm run build && npm run test:pwa && npm run verify:field --workspace @poseidon/web
